is: The `nodes` plugin: `/nodes:chart` to build or refresh a repository's NODE.inf.json tree, and `/nodes:familiarize` to load it silently at session start, both driving the external `nodes` binary.
conventions: every node read and write goes through the `nodes` binary (0.7.0 or later); a skill never writes a node file by hand
no scripts and no hooks, so the skills run the same on Linux, macOS and Windows
the pack's per-project settings are the root NODE.toml's `[tool]`, `[refs]` and `[root]` tables, seeded once by /nodes:chart and never overwritten

fs.name: README.md
fs.role: the pack's manual: binary install, NODE.toml settings, committed vs local-only trees, the pointer rule, commands for other agents

fs.name: skills/
fs.role: chart/ (/nodes:chart, two-pass incremental charting with --full, --dry, --diff) and familiarize/ (/nodes:familiarize, read-only loader that replies Ready.)

notes: the `nodes` binary lives in a separate repo (ZurNetwork/nodes) and is not built here; on every machine update the plugin before the binary
zaf puts `nodes chain` output for each owned path into a task's brief pack when the binary is on PATH, so programmers get node context without loading this pack

whether a repository's tree is committed or kept local-only is decided per repository at the first chart, using the same ownership test (`WAYS_OWN_ORGS`) the root README applies to every pack's project files
